---
title: "How much light?"
---

Pick the hours of direct sun your window gets and see which plants will be happy.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof hours = Inputs.range([0, 10], {value: 5, step: 0.5, label: "Sun hours"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
herbs = [
  {name: "Mint", need: 3}, {name: "Lettuce", need: 3}, {name: "Chives", need: 4},
  {name: "Parsley", need: 4}, {name: "Basil", need: 6}, {name: "Rosemary", need: 7}, {name: "Tomato", need: 8}
]
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 80,
  x: {label: "Hours of sun needed", domain: [0, 10]},
  y: {label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(herbs, {y: "name", x: "need", sort: {y: "x"}, fill: d => d.need <= hours ? "#5fb37c" : "#8b98a5"}),
    Plot.ruleX([hours], {stroke: "#e0a458", strokeWidth: 3}),
    Plot.text(herbs, {y: "name", x: "need", text: d => d.need <= hours ? "happy" : "needs more sun", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
happy = herbs.filter(d => d.need <= hours).map(d => d.name)
md`**${happy.length} of ${herbs.length}** plants are happy with ${hours} hours: ${happy.length ? happy.join(", ") : "none yet, try a grow light."}`
```

Green bars are plants that thrive at your chosen light level. The orange line is your window.
